

```{r}
#| label: anomalias
#| echo: false


# --- Packages ---
pacman::p_load("sf","terra","dplyr","stringr","ggplot2",
          "rnaturalearth","rnaturalearthdata","curl","R.utils", "tidyr")

# --- Temp dirs ---
td <-  "_data/"  # tempfile("latam_anom_"); dir.create(td, showWarnings = FALSE)
td_ecos <- file.path(td,"ecos"); dir.create(td_ecos, FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# 1) BOUNDARIES / MASKS
# =============================================================================

# 1A. Latin America & Caribbean (LAC) using rnaturalearth
admin <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = 10, returnclass = "sf") |> 
  st_make_valid()
lac <- admin |>
  filter(subregion %in% c("South America","Central America","Caribbean") |
           name %in% c("Mexico","México") | name_long %in% c("Mexico","México")) |>
  st_union() |> st_as_sf() |> st_set_crs(4326)

# 1B. WWF/RESOLVE ecoregions (2017) – attribute fields include REALM, BIOME_NAME, ECO_NAME
# (official download)
eco_zip <- file.path(td_ecos, "Ecoregions2017.zip")
curl::curl_download("https://storage.googleapis.com/teow2016/Ecoregions2017.zip", eco_zip)
unzip(eco_zip, exdir = td_ecos)

eco_shp <- list.files(td_ecos, pattern = "\\.shp$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)[1]
eco <- st_read(eco_shp, quiet = TRUE) |> st_make_valid() |> st_transform(4326)

# Restrict ecoregions to LAC footprint to keep things light
eco_latam <- st_intersection(eco, lac)

# --- Amazonía (hidrográfica) desde HydroBASINS (Nivel 5) ---
# Fuente: HydroBASINS, continente SA. (Si prefieres otro nivel, cambia 'lev05' por 'lev04' o 'lev06'.)
hb_zip <- file.path(td, "hybas_sa_lev01-12_v1c.zip")
hb_dir <- file.path(td, "Amazon"); dir.create(hb_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

curl::curl_download("https://data.hydrosheds.org/file/hydrobasins/standard/hybas_sa_lev01-12_v1c.zip", hb_zip)
utils::unzip(hb_zip, exdir = hb_dir)

hb_shp <- list.files(hb_dir, pattern = "lev05_v1c\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE)[1]
hb <- st_read(hb_shp, quiet = TRUE) |> st_make_valid() |> st_transform(4326)

# Punto cerca de la desembocadura del Amazonas (Amapá, Brasil)
mouth <- st_sfc(st_point(c(-50.5, -1.5)), crs = 4326)

# Subcuenca más cercana; obtenemos su MAIN_BAS (id de cuenca principal)
idx <- st_nearest_feature(mouth, hb)
amazon_main <- hb$MAIN_BAS[idx]

# Unimos TODAS las subcuencas con ese MAIN_BAS -> cuenca amazónica completa
amazon <- hb |>
  filter(MAIN_BAS == amazon_main) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")

# (Opcional) Guardar a disco para reutilizar
# sf::st_write(amazon, "amazon_hydrobasins.gpkg", "amazon_basin", delete_dsn = TRUE)


# ------------------------------
# # 1C. AMAZON mask – robust basin boundary (JRC/EC “Amazonia” limit)
# # (If this URL is flaky for you, RAISG also publishes an Amazonia boundary; swap in their shapefile.)
# jrc_zip <- file.path(td, "amazon_jrc.zip")
# curl::curl_download("https://forobs.jrc.ec.europa.eu/amazon/data/amazonia_shp.zip", jrc_zip)
# unzip(jrc_zip, exdir = file.path(td,"amazon"))
# 
# amazon_shp <- list.files(file.path(td,"amazon"), pattern="\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE)[1]
# amazon <- st_read(amazon_shp, quiet = TRUE) |> st_make_valid() |> st_transform(4326)
# --------------------------
  

# 1D. PÁRAMO mask – union all ecoregions whose name contains “Páramo/Paramo”
paramo <- eco_latam |>
  filter(str_detect(ECO_NAME, regex("P[áa]ramo", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
  st_union() |> st_as_sf(crs = 4326)

# 1E. DRY FOREST mask – WWF biome “Tropical & Subtropical Dry Broadleaf Forests”
dryforest <- eco_latam |>
  filter(BIOME_NAME == "Tropical & Subtropical Dry Broadleaf Forests") |>
  st_union() |> st_as_sf(crs = 4326)

coral <- eco_latam |>
  filter(BIOME_NAME == "coral") |>
  st_union() |> st_as_sf(crs = 4326)

# Ensure singlepart polygons are valid
fix_geom <- function(sfobj) sf::st_make_valid(sfobj) |> st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")
lac <- fix_geom(lac); 
amazon <- fix_geom(amazon); 
paramo <- fix_geom(paramo); 
dryforest <- fix_geom(dryforest)
#coral <- fix_geom(coral)

# =============================================================================
# 2) DATA: GISTEMP v4 monthly gridded anomalies (land-only, 2°×2°)
#     Baseline is 1951–1980 (already anomalies)
# =============================================================================
# Source page lists the NetCDF links (land-only: 250 km smoothing).
# If direct download fails (CDN downtime), fetch manually from the page noted below.
gistemp_gz <- file.path(td, "gistemp250_GHCNv4.nc.gz")
curl::curl_download("https://data.giss.nasa.gov/pub/gistemp/gistemp250_GHCNv4.nc.gz", gistemp_gz)
nc_path <- R.utils::gunzip(gistemp_gz, remove = FALSE, overwrite = TRUE)

r <- terra::rast(nc_path)            # layers = monthly anomalies
# Weight by cell area (km^2)
w <- terra::cellSize(r, unit = "km")

# Helper: area-weighted mean anomaly for a polygon
awm_ts <- function(poly, r, w, name){
  m <- terra::mask(r, vect(poly))
  w_m <- terra::mask(w, vect(poly))
  # denominator (sum of weights over valid cells)
  den <- as.numeric(global(w_m, "sum", na.rm = TRUE))
  # weighted sum per layer, then divide by denom
  num <- global(m * w_m, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[,1]
  vals <- as.numeric(num / den)
  # Build date index; terra usually parses NetCDF time, fallback to monthly from 1880-01
  tvec <- tryCatch(terra::time(r), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(tvec) || any(is.na(tvec))) {
    # fallback: 1880-01 mid-month start
    start <- as.Date("1880-01-15")
    tvec <- seq.Date(start, by = "1 month", length.out = nlyr(r))
  } else {
    tvec <- as.Date(tvec)
  }
  tibble(region = name, date = tvec, anomaly = vals)
}

ts_lac     <- awm_ts(lac, r, w, "Latin America") 
ts_amazon  <- awm_ts(amazon, r, w, "Amazon")
ts_paramo  <- awm_ts(paramo, r, w, "P\u00E1ramo")
ts_dry     <- awm_ts(dryforest, r, w, "Dry forest")
#coral      <- awm_ts(coral, r, w, "Coral reefs")

ts_all <- bind_rows(ts_lac, ts_amazon, ts_paramo, ts_dry) 

# Annual means (calendar year)
ts_annual <- ts_all |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) |>
  group_by(region, year) |>
  summarise(anomaly = mean(anomaly, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
  drop_na()

# =============================================================================
# 3) PLOT
# =============================================================================
gg <- ggplot(ts_annual, aes(x = year, y = anomaly, color = region)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Temperature anomaly (1951–1980 baseline)",
       subtitle = "Area-weighted annual means (GISTEMP v4, 2°×2° land-only)\nLatin America vs. Amazon, Páramo, and Tropical Dry Forests",
       x = NULL, y = "Anomaly (°C)", color = NULL,
       caption = "Data: NASA GISTEMP v4; Boundaries: RESOLVE/WWF ecoregions (2017), JRC Amazon; Countries: Natural Earth") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
